title: Allow Human/Ops owner closeout of peer-approved merged tasks without Task Brief fabrication

reproduction.normal_done_rejection: validate_active_status_command_lease('done', ...) raises RuntimeError('local Human/Ops cannot authorize done; allowed actions are ...') because done is not in LOCAL_HUMAN_OPS_ACTIONS
reproduction.legacy_reconcile_merged_done_rejection_o: prepare_external_mutation_preflight('reconcile_merged_done', ...) fell into validate_merged_done_evidence(task) and raised SystemExit('RECONCILE_EVIDENCE_FILE is required for reconcile_merged_done') even when status == 'review_approved', owner == 'Human/Ops', reviewer == 'Antigravity', frozen PR/head/manifest delivery_binding and review_binding matched, delivery was merged to origin/dev, and completion_tracks.hosted was done with evidence

repair_summary.mechanism: Added validate_human_ops_owner_merged_delivery(task) and wired it into prepare_external_mutation_preflight('reconcile_merged_done', ...) when RECONCILE_EVIDENCE_FILE is unset for a Human/Ops-owned task or explicit local Human/Ops review_approved closeout. Reuses require_current_pr_delivery_binding(task, action='reconcile') directly (without synthesizing missing review_file), exact_head_acceptance_available, _validated_pr_binding, _validated_reconcile_delivery (exact reviewed head merged to target), validate_hosted_completion (via validate_task_lifecycle_transition), and validate_protected_closeout_transition. Preserves lost-review-state recovery via RECONCILE_EVIDENCE_FILE unchanged.

results.focused_regression_tests: Ran 2 tests in 0.073s - OK (failed on unpatched base with SystemExit: RECONCILE_EVIDENCE_FILE is required for reconcile_merged_done; passed after patch)
